nodes.name: Financial Engine
nodes.purpose: Manages all invoicing, payouts, subscriptions, and financial records for the platform.
nodes.ux_intent: Financial tracking should feel invisible to clients and provide ultimate confidence to workers.
nodes.vertical_notes: Handles caregiving hourly rates (with holiday/overtime) and cleaning flat rates or quoted prices.

nodes.name: Invoicing
nodes.purpose: Handles the generation, delivery, and lifecycle of invoices for completed work or scheduled services.
nodes.ux_intent: Invoices should be effortlessly generated, instantly delivered, and easily payable in one tap.
nodes.vertical_notes: Caregiving invoices often have complex hourly breakdowns; cleaning invoices are typically flat-rate line items.

nodes.name: Create Post-Assignment Invoice
nodes.purpose: Automatically generates an invoice immediately after an assignment is completed based on logged hours or flat rates.
nodes.ux_intent: Zero mental math for clients; itemized breakdowns ensure transparent, undisputed billing.
open_questions: Should we auto-deduct from payment methods on file immediately upon creation?
nodes.vertical_notes: Nanny: calculated from hours worked x rate + 20% emergency premium if applicable. Cleaning: flat rate + travel allowance.
nodes.case_integration: Invoice generation serves as a financial timestamp for completed work proof.

nodes.name: Create Cancellation Fee Invoice
nodes.purpose: Generates a penalty invoice when a client cancels a booking outside of the allowed grace period.
nodes.ux_intent: Enforces policy fairly without requiring worker confrontation, protecting worker income.
nodes.vertical_notes: Cancellation fees protect caregiving block bookings and high-value deep clean slots.

nodes.name: Create Manual Invoice
nodes.purpose: Allows administrators to draft custom invoices for bespoke services or one-off charges.
nodes.ux_intent: Provides ultimate flexibility for the agency to handle edge cases easily.
nodes.vertical_notes: Used for bespoke deep cleans or ad-hoc nanny expenses not logged in app.

nodes.name: Send Invoice
nodes.purpose: Dispatches the generated invoice to the client via email and/or SMS.
nodes.ux_intent: Clients receive a beautiful, clear summary with a prominent 'Pay Now' button.
nodes.vertical_notes: Both registered and anonymous clients receive these notifications.

nodes.name: Send Anon Payment Link
nodes.purpose: Generates and sends a secure, tokenized payment link for clients who do not have registered accounts.
nodes.ux_intent: Anonymous clients can pay securely in seconds via Apple Pay or card without creating a password.
open_questions: How long should the tokenized link remain valid?
nodes.vertical_notes: Critical for one-off emergency caregiving bookings or single end-of-tenancy cleans.

nodes.name: Mark Invoice Paid
nodes.purpose: Updates the invoice state to paid upon successful payment gateway webhook or manual cash confirmation.
nodes.ux_intent: Immediate visual reassurance with a satisfying green tick that the debt is settled.
nodes.vertical_notes: Unlocks payout availability for the worker.
nodes.case_integration: Triggers 'Earnings Verified' proof status in Case Portfolio.

nodes.name: Mark Invoice Overdue
nodes.purpose: Background job that sweeps for unpaid invoices past their due date and updates their status.
nodes.ux_intent: Automated bad-debt tracking relieves admins of manual ledger checking.
nodes.vertical_notes: Can trigger automated follow-up SMS to parents or property managers.

nodes.name: Void Invoice
nodes.purpose: Cancels an unpaid invoice, removing the debt obligation.
nodes.ux_intent: Provides an undo button for administrative errors with clean audit trails.
nodes.vertical_notes: Used if a cleaning was fundamentally botched and the agency waives the fee.

nodes.name: Download Invoice PDF
nodes.purpose: Generates a PDF version of the invoice for client record-keeping and tax purposes.
nodes.ux_intent: Instant access to professional, branded tax-ready documents.
nodes.vertical_notes: Important for clients claiming childcare tax credits or landlords expensing cleaning.

nodes.name: View Payment Status
nodes.purpose: Allows anonymous clients to check if their invoice is paid using their unique link token.
nodes.ux_intent: Frictionless peace of mind for anon users to confirm their payment went through.
nodes.vertical_notes: Prevents support calls from one-off clients asking 'did you get my payment?'

nodes.name: Payouts
nodes.purpose: Manages calculating and transferring earnings to workers.
nodes.ux_intent: Workers should see exactly what they earned and trust that payouts happen like clockwork.
nodes.vertical_notes: Handles agency commission splits and manages worker payout cycles.

nodes.name: Calculate Payout
nodes.purpose: Computes worker earnings by taking invoice totals, deducting agency commission, and adding statutory accruals like holiday pay.
nodes.ux_intent: Transparent, line-by-line breakdown showing the worker exactly how their payout is derived.
nodes.vertical_notes: Applies agency % (e.g., 15%). Auto-accrues 12.07% for UK nanny holiday pay. Adds cleaner travel allowance directly to net.
nodes.case_integration: Payout calculations provide the 'Verified Earnings' data point for Case Portfolio.

nodes.name: Disburse Payout
nodes.purpose: Executes the actual transfer of funds to the worker's bank account via the payment rail.
nodes.ux_intent: 'Cha-ching' moment. Seamless and punctual bank transfers.
nodes.vertical_notes: Occurs on weekly cycle (default) or immediately per-assignment if instant payout is enabled.

nodes.name: Handle Payout Failure
nodes.purpose: Detects bounced or failed bank transfers and pauses the payout while notifying the worker to update bank details.
nodes.ux_intent: Proactive, non-alarming notifications guiding the worker to fix the issue quickly.
nodes.vertical_notes: Crucial for workers heavily relying on weekly income.

nodes.name: View Worker Earnings Dashboard
nodes.purpose: Displays a real-time summary of a worker's upcoming, processing, and completed payouts.
nodes.ux_intent: A beautiful, reassuring ledger that makes the worker feel valued and financially secure.
nodes.vertical_notes: Cleaners can see travel allowances explicitly broken out; Nannies see holiday pay pools.

nodes.name: View Payout History
nodes.purpose: Provides a paginated, filterable list of all historical payouts for a worker.
nodes.ux_intent: Effortless tax-time preparation with easy exports.
nodes.vertical_notes: Supports detailed tracing in case a nanny contests a specific week's pay.

nodes.name: Subscriptions
nodes.purpose: Manages automated, recurring billing for regular clients.
nodes.ux_intent: 'Set it and forget it'. Clients enjoy uninterrupted service without manually paying weekly.
nodes.vertical_notes: Essential for weekly recurring domestic cleaning and daily wrap-around nanny care.

nodes.name: Create Subscription
nodes.purpose: Initializes a recurring billing agreement linked to a recurring service schedule.
nodes.ux_intent: A single tap confirms the recurring mandate, fading into the background forever.
nodes.vertical_notes: Auto-collects weekly for recurring cleaners or daily nannies.

nodes.name: Process Subscription Cycle
nodes.purpose: Automatically generates an invoice and charges the default payment method based on the schedule.
nodes.ux_intent: Zero friction; the system quietly handles the exchange of value.
nodes.vertical_notes: Aggregates hours for nannies or counts visits for cleaners to build the invoice.

nodes.name: Pause Subscription
nodes.purpose: Temporarily halts recurring billing (e.g., when the client goes on holiday).
nodes.ux_intent: Friendly flexibility; no penalization for taking a vacation.
nodes.vertical_notes: Often used during school holidays when nanny requirements change drastically.

nodes.name: Resume Subscription
nodes.purpose: Reactivates a paused subscription, resuming automated billing.
nodes.ux_intent: Smooth re-entry into standard service without setup hassle.
nodes.vertical_notes: Automatically resumes after family returns from holiday.

nodes.name: Cancel Subscription
nodes.purpose: Permanently stops the recurring billing agreement.
nodes.ux_intent: No trapdoors; easy cancellation builds long-term trust.
open_questions: Should cancellation require a notice period (e.g., 2 weeks)?
nodes.vertical_notes: Ends the regular domestic cleaning or permanent nanny placement.

nodes.name: Ledger
nodes.purpose: Provides a double-entry accounting log of every single money movement in the system.
nodes.ux_intent: Absolute source of truth for the agency, ensuring zero lost pennies and perfect compliance.
nodes.vertical_notes: Records cash-in-hand tips or manual expense reimbursements (e.g., nanny buying groceries).

nodes.name: Create Ledger Entry
nodes.purpose: Writes an immutable transaction record (credit/debit) into the ledger.
nodes.ux_intent: Frictionless programmatic logging of all financial state changes.
nodes.vertical_notes: Admin uses this to log manual cash payments outside the app.

nodes.name: View Ledger
nodes.purpose: Allows admins to inspect the timeline of all financial transactions.
nodes.ux_intent: A powerful, intuitive search interface for finding specific transactions instantly.
nodes.vertical_notes: Used to audit individual client balances or total worker payouts.

nodes.name: Export Ledger
nodes.purpose: Exports ledger data into CSV or accounting software formats.
nodes.ux_intent: One-click handoff to Xero or QuickBooks, making month-end a breeze.
nodes.vertical_notes: Critical for agency accountants dealing with large volumes of micro-transactions.

nodes.name: Escrow Management
nodes.purpose: Holds funds securely for unclaimed/shadow workers until they claim their account.
nodes.ux_intent: Ensures workers that their money is safe and waiting for them the moment they log in.
nodes.vertical_notes: Important for agencies migrating to the platform where workers haven't finished onboarding.

nodes.name: Hold Funds in Escrow
nodes.purpose: Routes calculated payouts into an escrow holding state for inactive or shadow workers.
nodes.ux_intent: Safely parks funds automatically without manual admin intervention.
nodes.vertical_notes: Complies with temporary withholding for non-verified cleaners.

nodes.name: Release Escrow Funds
nodes.purpose: Transfers accumulated escrow funds into the active payout queue once a worker is fully onboarded.
nodes.ux_intent: Immediate gratification and trust-building as newly joined workers see instant balances.
nodes.vertical_notes: Triggers a bulk payout for shadow nannies who finally claim their profile.

nodes.name: Settlements
nodes.purpose: Computes the total agency net revenue, resolving client payments against worker payouts and fees.
nodes.ux_intent: Clear separation of agency capital vs. worker liability.
nodes.vertical_notes: Abstracts the complexity of split routing and payment gateway fees.

nodes.name: Compute Settlement
nodes.purpose: Calculates the exact amount owed to the agency's operational bank account after all deductions.
nodes.ux_intent: Automated reconciliation gives agency owners peace of mind regarding their margins.
nodes.vertical_notes: Accounts for Stripe fees vs Agency Commission.

nodes.name: Finalize Settlement
nodes.purpose: Executes the transfer of the computed revenue to the agency's master account.
nodes.ux_intent: Agency gets paid smoothly, finalizing the financial lifecycle.
nodes.vertical_notes: Consolidates all the 15% commissions from caregiving/cleaning into one bulk transfer.

nodes.name: Revenue Reporting
nodes.purpose: Provides high-level business intelligence on agency profitability and volume.
nodes.ux_intent: Beautiful, actionable charts that make agency owners feel in control of their growth.
nodes.vertical_notes: Allows splitting revenue view by vertical (Caregiving vs Cleaning).

nodes.name: View Revenue Dashboard
nodes.purpose: Renders visual widgets (MRR, GMV, Churn) for the agency administrator.
nodes.ux_intent: Instantly understandable metrics at a glance.
nodes.vertical_notes: Admins can compare average lifetime value of a recurring cleaner client vs ad-hoc nanny client.

nodes.name: Export Revenue CSV
nodes.purpose: Downloads raw reporting data for external analysis.
nodes.ux_intent: Simple export format ready for Excel pivot tables.
nodes.vertical_notes: Standard feature for deeper offline financial modeling.

nodes.name: Holiday Pay (UK Statutory)
nodes.purpose: Automatically accrues and disperses statutory holiday pay for applicable workers.
nodes.ux_intent: Eliminates complex manual spreadsheets; workers feel secure their rights are upheld.
nodes.vertical_notes: Calculates exactly 12.07% of earnings on every nanny/caregiver invoice.

nodes.name: Accrue Holiday Pay
nodes.purpose: Deducts/allocates the 12.07% percentage from the invoice into a virtual holiday pot for the worker.
nodes.ux_intent: Invisible to the client, visibly reassuring to the worker in their earnings dashboard.
nodes.vertical_notes: Mainly applies to PAYE nannies or defined workers; some self-employed cleaners may be exempt depending on agency model.

nodes.name: Pay Out Holiday Pot
nodes.purpose: Disburses the accrued holiday funds when the worker takes time off or leaves the agency.
nodes.ux_intent: Worker receives their deserved time-off pay effortlessly with a simple request button.
nodes.vertical_notes: Allows nannies to take paid leave seamlessly during school holidays.
